english: Just how many beds does Adeline think I could possibly load up onto my cart?
french: Combien de lits Adeline croit-elle que je peux charger sur mon chariot ?
russian: Как много кроватей Аделина рассчитывает засунуть в мой фургон?
bulgarian: Just how many beds does Adeline think I could possibly load up onto my cart?

english: I'm as happy as the next person to make the King think well of me, but...
french: Comme n'importe qui, j'apprécie l'idée d'être tenu en estime par le roi, mais...
russian: Я не меньше других рад заслужить хорошую репутацию у короля, но...
bulgarian: I'm as happy as the next person to make the King think well of me, but...

english: I hope a taste of Mistrian cooking helps keep everyone's spirits up until the next harvest.
french: J'espère qu'un aperçu de la cuisine mistrienne aidera tout le monde à garder le moral jusqu'à la prochaine récolte.
russian: Надеюсь, вкус мистрийской кухни поднимет им дух до следующего урожая.
bulgarian: I hope a taste of Mistrian cooking helps keep everyone's spirits up until the next harvest.

english: Adeline told me you shipped out meals, [Ari]! I sent out a bunch too!
french: Adeline m'a dit que tu avais expédié des repas, [Ari] ! J'en ai envoyé pas mal, moi aussi !
russian: Аделина мне рассказала, что ты отсылаешь продовольствие, [Ari]! Я тоже наготовила для них блюд!
bulgarian: Adeline told me you shipped out meals, [Ari]! I sent out a bunch too!

english: Nice to have an excuse to do a little extra fishing!
french: C'est sympa d'avoir une excuse pour pêcher un peu plus longtemps !
russian: Отличное оправдание, чтобы лишний раз выбраться на рыбалку!
bulgarian: Nice to have an excuse to do a little extra fishing!

english: Aye, I shipped out a fair share of fish as well.
french: Ouaip, moi aussi j'ai envoyé pas mal de poisson.
russian: Да, я тоже отправила немало рыбы.
bulgarian: Aye, I shipped out a fair share of fish as well.

english: I'm so glad she liked them! She even wrote to me asking about tips to grow her own.
french: Je suis tellement contente qu'elles lui aient plu ! Elle m'a même écrit pour me demander des conseils afin qu'elle puisse en faire pousser elle-même.
russian: Я рада, что ей понравилось! Она даже написала мне и спросила совета, как вырастить такие же.
bulgarian: I'm so glad she liked them! She even wrote to me asking about tips to grow her own.

english: I'm a little nervous about writing back to a Princess though...
french: Je suis quand même un peu nerveuse à l'idée d'écrire à une princesse...
russian: Но мне слегка тревожно писать письмо принцессе...
bulgarian: I'm a little nervous about writing back to a Princess though...

english: I shipped some of the flowers I'm proudest of to Princess Delaphine.
french: J'ai envoyé certaines des fleurs dont je suis le plus fière à la princesse Delaphine.
russian: Я отобрала цветы, которыми горжусь больше всего, и отправила принцессе Делафине.
bulgarian: I shipped some of the flowers I'm proudest of to Princess Delaphine.

english: Of course, back then I just called him Briar.
french: Bien sûr, à cette époque-là, je l'appelais simplement par son prénom : Briar.
russian: Тогда, конечно, я его звала просто Кустик.
bulgarian: Of course, back then I just called him Briar.

english: I'm glad to see he's still as dedicated to his research as he was back then.
french: Je suis contente qu'il se consacre toujours autant à la recherche.
russian: Приятно слышать, что он с тех пор не бросил своих научных изысканий.
bulgarian: I'm glad to see he's still as dedicated to his research as he was back then.

english: The Royal Physician and I were in school together, you know.
french: Tu sais, nous avons fait nos études ensemble avec le médecin du roi.
russian: Знаешь, я училась в одной школе с придворным доктором.
bulgarian: The Royal Physician and I were in school together, you know.

english: Isn't it nice to know our cooking is going to people who need it?
french: C'est agréable de savoir que ce que l'on cuisine ira aux personnes qui en ont besoin, non ?
russian: Как приятно знать, что наша еда помогает людям!
bulgarian: Isn't it nice to know our cooking is going to people who need it?

english: I sent off a cauldron full of the Inn's $Vegetable Soup$ to help the Capital's Soup Kitchen.
french: J'ai envoyé à la capitale un chaudron rempli de la $soupe de légumes$ de l'auberge afin d'aider la soupe populaire.
russian: Я отправила на помощь столичной кухне полный котёл $овощного супа$.
bulgarian: I sent off a cauldron full of the Inn's $Vegetable Soup$ to help the Capital's Soup Kitchen.

english: Carting all that stone for the new retaining wall was extremely unprofitable.
french: Transporter toutes les pierres pour ce nouveau mur de soutènement a représenté un gros manque à gagner.
russian: Довозить все эти камни для подпорной стены было крайне неприбыльно.
bulgarian: Carting all that stone for the new retaining wall was extremely unprofitable.

english: I'm sure the villages beyond it would be grateful to meet the merchant who helped bring it in though.
french: Néanmoins, je suis sûr que les habitants des villages au-delà du mur seraient ravis de témoigner leur reconnaissance au marchand qui a participé à sa reconstruction.
russian: Хотя тамошние жители наверняка будут благодарны торговцу, который помог их привезти.
bulgarian: I'm sure the villages beyond it would be grateful to meet the merchant who helped bring it in though.

english: Don't get me wrong, I'm glad to help but...
french: Ne te méprends pas, ça me fait plaisir de donner un coup de main, mais...
russian: Не подумай ничего плохого: я рад помочь, но...
bulgarian: Don't get me wrong, I'm glad to help but...

english: I wonder if Eiland would be interested in loaning out some of our exhibits to help spread interest in Mistria even more!
french: Je me demande si cela intéresserait Eiland de prêter certaines de nos pièces d'exposition pour susciter encore plus d'intérêt envers Mistria !
russian: Я подумал: может быть, Эйланд захочет одолжить им несколько наших экспонатов. Так интерес к Мистрии вырастет ещё больше!
bulgarian: I wonder if Eiland would be interested in loaning out some of our exhibits to help spread interest in Mistria even more!

english: I've been receiving letters from museums all over Aldaria and beyond after you shipped off those shards, [Ari].
french: Suite aux éclats que tu as envoyés, des musées d'Aldaria et au-delà m'ont écrit, [Ari].
russian:
С тех пор, как ты

отправили

отправилаотправилотправило в столицу осколки, [Ari], мне стали слать письма из музеев со всех концов Альдарии.
bulgarian: I've been receiving letters from museums all over Aldaria and beyond after you shipped off those shards, [Ari].

english: Nice work.
french: Beau travail.
russian: Молодец.
bulgarian: Nice work.

english: Heard about how you helped out the orphanage in the Capital.
french: On m'a dit que tu avais aidé l'orphelinat de la capitale.
russian:
Слышал, ты

помогли

помоглапомогпомогло столичному приюту.
bulgarian: Heard about how you helped out the orphanage in the Capital.
